notes: NOT pixel-matching: AE's fractal-noise generator (lattice hash, interpolation) is proprietary; this shader is a statistically matched stand-in (cubic B-spline value noise, lattice 1.12 Size, AE fractal defaults for Complexity octaves), so the warp has AE's scale, strength, edge pinning and parameter behaviour but a different pattern — expect large per-pixel errors (13 % mean on the refs) while the look (wave size and amplitude of the displaced edges) is comparable. Model (from the earlier fit recorded in the shader header): D(p) = Amount/100 * Size * N((p - Offset)/Size); Pin All fades the component perpendicular to each layer edge with smoothstep over 0.84 Size. Popups from the plug-in strings: Displacement 1 Turbulent, 2 Bulge, 3 Twist, 4 (-, 5/6/7 Smoother versions, 8 (-, 9 Vertical, 10 Horizontal, 11 Cross; Pinning 1 None, 2 (-, 3 All, 4 Horizontal, 5 Vertical, 6 Left, 7 Right, 8 Top, 9 Bottom, 10 (-, 11..17 Locked versions (this pass fixed a Right/Top swap in the shader); Antialiasing 1 Low, 2 High. Unverified: Bulge/Twist/Smoother modes, Pin Horizontal = top+bottom edges, Evolution/Cycle/Random Seed behaviour (only the statistics are meaningful), separators 4/8 (rendered as Turbulent), Resize Layer.
